global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.name: Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees (GKS-U)
global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.covers: Tuition (NIIED pays up to ₩5 million a semester, the university covers the rest), a one-year Korean language course, an economy flight and ₩14,400,000 a year for living costs during the degree.

coverage_notes.tuition: Up to ₩5 million a semester from NIIED; the university pays any amount above it and the admission fee
coverage_notes.living: ₩14,400,000 a year in the degree (₩13,560,000 in the language year); includes housing and health insurance
coverage_notes.travel: Economy flight to Korea and home after the degree

global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.ca_note: All four countries are on the 2027 embassy-track list: Kazakhstan 4 places, Uzbekistan 3, Kyrgyzstan 3, Tajikistan 2. More places exist through the university track.
global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.age: Under 25 (for the 2027 round: born on or after 1 March 2002)
global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.grades: One of: 80% or higher, top 20% of the class, or a CGPA of at least 2.64/4.0 (2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5, 3.23/5.0)
global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.english: Not required. TOPIK (Korean) and TOEFL or IELTS scores earn points in the evaluation; TOPIK level 3 or higher also adds bonus points.
global-korea-scholarship-undergraduate.deadline_note: The 2027 round closed: embassy track online deadline was 30 September 2026, university track in November 2026. Students finishing school in 2027 apply in the 2028 round, expected in September 2027 (entry March 2028).
how_to_apply: Download the GKS-U guidelines from Study in Korea when the round opens (usually September).
Choose the embassy track (Korean embassy in your country) or the university track (apply straight to a Korean university).
Pick up to three universities from the list for your track and prepare your documents.
Submit online by the embassy or university deadline; keep an apostilled copy of your school certificate.
Pass the first round (documents, sometimes an interview), then the university round and NIIED's final check.
If selected, you start with one year of Korean language study, then your 4-year degree.
documents: School certificate and transcripts (apostilled or consular-certified)
TOPIK or English score report, if you have one

faq.q: Can I apply from Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan or Tajikistan?
faq.a: Yes. All four countries had embassy-track places in the 2027 round (Kazakhstan 4, Uzbekistan 3, Kyrgyzstan 3, Tajikistan 2). The university track is also open to them.

faq.q: Do I need to speak Korean?
faq.a: No. The first year is a Korean language course. If you already hold TOPIK level 5 or 6 you skip it and start the degree.

faq.q: I finish school in 2027. Which round is mine?
faq.a: The 2028 round. It usually opens in September of the year before entry, so expect applications around September 2027 for March 2028 entry.

faq.q: Can I apply to both tracks?
faq.a: Not at the same time. If you fail the first round of the embassy track you can still apply to the university track if its deadline has not passed.

mext-undergrad-2027.name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for Undergraduate Students
mext-undergrad-2027.covers: Tuition, entrance and exam fees at a Japanese national university, ¥117,000 a month and a return economy flight. Usually one preparatory year (Japanese language) before the degree.

coverage_notes.tuition: Entrance exam, matriculation and tuition fees waived
coverage_notes.travel: Economy flight to Japan and home after the degree

mext-undergrad-2027.ca_note: Open to nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan, which includes Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. You apply through the Japanese embassy in your own country.
mext-undergrad-2027.age: For the 2027 round: born on or after 2 April 2002
mext-undergrad-2027.grades: 12 years of school finished (or finishing) by March of the entry year. Each embassy sets its own written exams (usually maths, English and Japanese; sciences for science majors).
mext-undergrad-2027.english: No fixed score; the embassy exam tests English
mext-undergrad-2027.deadline_note: The 2027 round (arrival April 2027) took applications in spring 2026. If you finish school in 2027, your round is MEXT 2028: embassies usually recruit in April–May 2027, with exams May–August.
how_to_apply: In spring, check the Japanese embassy website in your country for the undergraduate MEXT call.
Read the guidelines, pick a field (social sciences/humanities or natural sciences) and up to three majors.
Send the application form, certificates and health form to the embassy by its deadline. Never send them to MEXT directly.
Sit the embassy's written exams and interview (first screening, May–August).
If recommended, MEXT places you in a preparatory year in Japan, then at a national university.
documents: Certificate of health signed by a doctor
School transcript for the last 3 years
Recommendation letter from your school principal
Exam certificates (e.g. IELTS, SAT), if you have them

faq.q: Can students from Central Asia apply?
faq.a: Yes. Applicants need the nationality of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan, and all four Central Asian countries qualify. Apply through the Japanese embassy in your country.

faq.q: Do I need to know Japanese?
faq.a: No, but you must be willing to learn it and study in Japanese. Most scholars spend the first year on a Japanese language and subjects course.

faq.q: How much is the monthly allowance?
faq.a: ¥117,000 a month in the 2027 guidelines, plus ¥2,000–3,000 in some designated regions. MEXT notes the amount can change with the budget.

faq.q: When should a 2027 school graduate apply?
faq.a: In the MEXT 2028 round. Embassies usually announce it in April–May of the year before arrival, so watch for spring 2027.

turkiye-burslari-bachelor.covers: Tuition, a university place, 6,500 TL a month for undergraduates, a one-year Turkish course, a dormitory place, health insurance and a flight at the start and end of studies.

coverage_notes.tuition: Tuition paid and a university place arranged
coverage_notes.living: 6,500 TL a month for bachelor's students (double for Merit scholars); free dormitory
coverage_notes.travel: One flight at the start and one when you graduate

turkiye-burslari-bachelor.ca_note: Open to citizens of all countries except Türkiye.
turkiye-burslari-bachelor.grades: No single minimum on the programme page. The Merit track asks for a 90% average plus exam results.
turkiye-burslari-bachelor.english: Not required for most programmes; you take a one-year Turkish course. English-taught programmes may ask for a certificate.
turkiye-burslari-bachelor.deadline_note: Applications run every year from 10 January to 20 February in the online TBBS system. Confirm the 2027 dates when the call opens.
how_to_apply: Create an account in the Türkiye Scholarships application system (TBBS) when it opens on 10 January.
Choose up to 12 bachelor's programmes at Turkish universities.
Fill in the form, write the motivation answers and upload your documents.
Submit before 20 February.
If shortlisted, attend an interview (in person or online), usually in spring.
Results come in summer; you start with a Turkish language year.
documents: National exam results (e.g. UNT, ORT), SAT or similar, if you have them
Language certificate if a programme asks for it

faq.q: Can I apply before I finish school?
faq.a: Yes. Students in their final school year can apply with a transcript and submit the diploma later.
Usually not. Most programmes teach in Turkish after a one-year Turkish course that the scholarship pays for.
6,500 TL a month for undergraduates, according to the programme page. Merit scholars get twice that.

stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor.amount_headline: HUF 43,700 a month + free tuition + housing
stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor.covers: Free tuition, HUF 43,700 a month for 12 months a year, a free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 a month towards rent, and health insurance. The money is a contribution, not your full living cost.

coverage_notes.living: HUF 43,700 a month (about €110) and a dorm place or HUF 40,000 a month for housing
coverage_notes.insurance: Hungarian health care plus up to HUF 65,000 a year of extra insurance

stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor.ca_note: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are all on the official list of sending partners. You must also be nominated by your country's ministry, and the levels and fields on offer differ by country.
stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor.english: Set by each university (many English-taught programmes ask for IELTS 5.5–6.0 or similar)
stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor.deadline_note: There is one deadline a year, in mid-January (the 2026/27 call closed on 15 January 2026). Expect the 2027/28 deadline around mid-January 2027; confirm on the official site.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 call: applications to Tempus and your sending partner

how_to_apply: Check what your country's sending partner (usually the ministry of education) offers this year.
Pick up to two programmes in the Study Finder on stipendiumhungaricum.hu.
Apply online to Tempus Public Foundation and do any separate step your ministry asks for, by the January deadline.
Your ministry nominates candidates; then the universities run their own entrance exams or interviews (spring).
Results are published by the end of June; you apply for a visa in summer.

faq.a: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are all sending partners. Each partner decides which levels and how many places it offers, so check your ministry's notice.

faq.q: Is the stipend enough to live on?
faq.a: No. The official site says the money is only a contribution to living costs, so plan some savings of your own, especially in Budapest.

faq.q: Do I have to learn Hungarian?
faq.a: Full-time bachelor's and master's students take a free compulsory Hungarian course, but you can study your degree in English.

sources.title: Stipendium Hungaricum: what the scholarship covers

csc-type-a-bachelor.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC), bilateral route for bachelor's
csc-type-a-bachelor.covers: Tuition, a dormitory place, a monthly living allowance and medical insurance, through the Chinese embassy in your country.
csc-type-a-bachelor.ca_note: The scholarship is open to non-Chinese citizens; bachelor's applicants go through the Chinese embassy (or the agency it names) in their own country.
csc-type-a-bachelor.grades: From the 2027/28 round, bachelor's applicants need a valid CSCA exam score report
csc-type-a-bachelor.english: Set by the university (Chinese-taught programmes ask for HSK)
csc-type-a-bachelor.deadline_note: Each embassy sets its own deadline for the 2027/28 round; published examples fall in February 2027 (Indonesia: 14 February 2027). CSCA exam sittings run in November–December 2026 and January 2027.
how_to_apply: Find the 2027/28 scholarship notice of the Chinese embassy in your country and note its agency number and deadline.
Choose universities and programmes; ask them for a pre-admission letter.
Register for the CSCA exam and get your score report before the deadline.
Fill in the online application at campuschina.org with the embassy's agency number and upload documents.
Send paper copies to the embassy only if its notice asks for them. Results come in summer.

sources.title: Example 2027/28 embassy notice (Chinese Embassy in Indonesia)

el-yurt-umidi-bachelor.covers: Full tuition paid to the university, visas, a return flight, a monthly allowance for housing, food and books, and international medical insurance. Costs you already paid are not refunded.

coverage_notes.living: Monthly allowance for housing, food and study materials

el-yurt-umidi-bachelor.english: A language certificate that meets the Foundation's rules (IELTS, TOEFL or TestDaF)
el-yurt-umidi-bachelor.grades: An unconditional offer from a foreign university: top-100 universities get a fast priority route; universities up to the top 500 in priority fields go through an open competition
el-yurt-umidi-bachelor.deadline_note: Competitions open in sessions at least twice a year; dates are announced by the Foundation.
how_to_apply: Get an unconditional offer from a foreign university that is on the Foundation's list.
Get your language certificate (IELTS, TOEFL or TestDaF).
Wait for a session to open and apply online on the Foundation's platform.
Top-100 offers go through a short priority procedure; others take part in the competition (tests and interview).
Sign the contract: after graduating you work 3–5 years in Uzbekistan, or repay twice the cost.

faq.q: Do I have to come back to Uzbekistan?
faq.a: Yes. Graduates must return and work 3 to 5 years in ministries, state organisations or universities. Otherwise they repay double the cost.

faq.q: Do I need the university offer first?
faq.a: Yes. The Foundation asks for an official unconditional offer from the foreign university.

bolashak-bachelor-olympiad-2027.provider: Government of Kazakhstan (Center for International Programs)
bolashak-bachelor-olympiad-2027.ca_note: For citizens of Kazakhstan only. Since 2026 the bachelor's category is only for winners and prize-winners of approved international school Olympiads and science-project competitions.
bolashak-bachelor-olympiad-2027.grades: A winner's or prize-winner's diploma from an approved international Olympiad or science-project competition, in a field that matches your planned degree

faq.q: Can any good student get Bolashak for a bachelor's?
faq.a: No. Since 2026 the bachelor's category is only for winners and prize-winners of approved international Olympiads and science-project competitions.

chevening-scholarships.ca_note: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan all have Chevening country pages. The award is for a one-year master's in the UK after a bachelor's degree and work experience, so it is not for school leavers.
